claude_proposed_widenings.name: disbelieve_illusion
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Study-action Investigation check's onPass effect is that the creature can see through the image and its other sensory qualities become faint. This is a creature-specific perception state change with deterministic mechanical consequences (the creature bypasses the illusion's concealment). No existing EffectAtom captures a creature-local illusion bypass/reveal. { kind: 'none' } was used as a known-gap placeholder to get the gate structure into the trace. Same gap as Silent Image.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: concentration.permanentAtSlot
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: At slot 4+, the duration changes from concentration (up to 10 minutes) to permanent (until dispelled, no concentration). The existing DurationUpcastTier only supports amount changes within the same duration kind; there is no mechanism to change the kind (concentration → permanent) at a slot threshold. The True Polymorph permanentIfMaintainedFull flag is maintenance-based, not slot-based — a different shape is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration, if cast with a level 4+ spell slot.
